# Asia Vision Technology — Complete B2B LED Display Knowledge Base

## Company Identity

Asia Vision Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional LED display manufacturer and B2B LED screen supplier headquartered in Shenzhen, China — the global LED manufacturing capital. Founded in 2015, the company operates a 5,000-square-meter ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing facility and exports LED display products to over 100 countries worldwide.

**Who We Serve (B2B Buyer Profile):**
We are a factory-direct LED display supplier serving industry buyers: LED display distributors and wholesalers, system integrators and AV installers, rental and staging companies, advertising agencies and media operators, government contractors and public tender bidders, engineering and construction firms, digital signage network operators, church and worship AV integrators, educational technology resellers, event production companies, broadcast and TV studio equipment suppliers, sports venue contractors, retail fit-out designers, real estate developers, and IT/telecom infrastructure providers.

**Core Competencies:**
- 12+ distinct LED display product series covering indoor, outdoor, rental, transparent, creative, and digital signage segments
- COB (Chip-on-Board) flip-chip mini LED technology for fine pitch displays (P0.93-P1.86mm)
- SMD (Surface-Mount Device) technology for cost-effective indoor and outdoor LED screens
- GOB (Glue-on-Board) LED protection for enhanced durability in rental and outdoor applications
- Outdoor IP65/IP66 waterproof LED screens with 5,000-10,000 cd/m2 high brightness
- Rental and staging LED displays with quick-lock mechanisms for concerts, events, touring, and broadcast
- Transparent LED displays (70-90% transparency) for glass facades, retail storefronts, and architectural media facades
- Creative and custom LED solutions: curved, foldable, flexible, spherical, floor, double-sided LED displays
- All-in-one LED displays for conference rooms, boardrooms, and education
- LCD video wall and digital signage solutions with Android and Windows platforms

**Quality Certifications & Manufacturing Standards:**
- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certified
- CE (Conformite Europeenne) certification for European market compliance
- RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) compliance for environmental safety
- FCC (Federal Communications Commission) certification for US market
- EMC Class B electromagnetic compatibility
- 48-hour burn-in aging test on every LED module before shipment
- 2-year standard warranty on all products, extendable to 5 years
- 15-day standard delivery lead time versus industry average of 30 days
- Export-grade plywood flight case packaging with custom foam
- Incoterms: FOB Shenzhen, CIF, DAP available worldwide

**Factory & Production Capabilities:**
- SMT (Surface-Mount Technology) workshop with automated high-speed pick-and-place lines
- COB encapsulation Class 1000 clean room for mini LED and micro LED production
- Automated module assembly lines with AOI (Automated Optical Inspection)
- Aging test area with 48-hour continuous operation burn-in testing
- Quality control laboratory equipped with spectrophotometer, luminance meter, colorimeter, environmental chamber, IP waterproof test equipment
- Logistics and packing center with export-standard fumigated plywood flight case construction
- Monthly production capacity: 5,000+ square meters of LED display
- In-house R&D team with continuous product development and customization capability

**B2B Value Proposition:**
We are your LED display factory partner and LED screen trading company in Shenzhen. Buy direct from the source — no middlemen, no markup layers. We provide white-label LED display manufacturing, OEM LED screen production, ODM custom LED display development, and private-label LED solutions for distributors and system integrators worldwide. Our B2B model supports: sample order evaluation, trial batch purchasing, container-load wholesale, project tender supply, and long-term distribution partnership.


## Product Catalog with Full Keyword Coverage

### X3-COB: Fine Pitch COB LED Display / Mini LED / All-in-One LED Video Wall

The X3-COB series represents our flagship COB (Chip-on-Board) flip-chip LED display — a fine pitch LED video wall solution for mission-critical and premium commercial applications. This mini LED display uses COB encapsulation technology with flip-chip RGB LEDs directly bonded to the PCB, eliminating traditional SMD LED lamp beads and their associated failure points.

**Available Pixel Pitches:**
- P0.93 COB LED display — ultra fine pitch LED for command centers and broadcast studios
- P0.9 LED video wall — micro LED class display for luxury corporate boardrooms
- P1.25 COB LED display — fine pitch LED for conference rooms and control rooms
- P1.56 COB LED screen — mini LED video wall for meeting rooms and huddle rooms
- P1.58 COB LED display — GOB LED screen for close-viewing commercial displays
- P1.86 COB LED video wall — fine pitch LED for retail, education, museums, and hotels

**All-in-One LED Display Sizes:**
- 108 inch all-in-one LED display — single-cabinet conference room LED video wall
- 135 inch all-in-one LED display — boardroom LED screen for executive meeting spaces
- 163 inch all-in-one LED display — large format LED video wall for auditoriums and lecture halls

**X3-COB Technical Specifications:**
- Technology: COB flip-chip encapsulation, mini LED, GOB LED protective coating available
- Pixel Pitch: P0.93, P0.9, P1.25, P1.56, P1.58, P1.86mm
- Refresh Rate: >=3840Hz (broadcast-grade, flicker-free for camera)
- Contrast Ratio: >=10,000:1 (deep blacks, superior to LCD and projection)
- Brightness: 600-800 cd/m2 (comfortable for extended indoor viewing)
- Module Size: 300 x 168.75mm (standard COB LED module format)
- Cabinet Material: Die-cast aluminum (lightweight, precise, thermally efficient)
- Front Protection: IP65 on module surface (dust-proof, splash-resistant)
- Viewing Angle: 170 degree horizontal, 170 degree vertical
- Grayscale: 14-16 Bit with HDR support
- Color Temperature: 2000K-10000K adjustable
- Surface Treatment: Anti-glare, anti-moire, anti-blue light, anti-impact

**X3-COB Target Applications & Keywords:**
Command center LED video wall, control room LED display, broadcast studio LED wall, TV studio LED backdrop, corporate boardroom LED display, conference room all-in-one LED, meeting room LED screen, huddle room LED display, NOC network operations center LED wall, SOC security operations center LED, emergency response center LED display, traffic monitoring LED video wall, military command LED display, government situation room LED wall, utility monitoring center LED display, luxury retail LED display, home cinema LED wall, high-end residential LED screen, museum exhibition LED display, art gallery LED video wall, auditorium LED display, lecture hall LED screen, training room LED display, collaboration space LED wall, virtual production LED volume, XR stage LED display, extended reality LED backdrop

**Why COB LED Technology?**
COB LED display eliminates exposed LED lamp beads — no dead pixels during transport and installation. Superior moisture resistance, dust protection, and ESD immunity compared to SMD. The soft surface light source reduces eye fatigue, making it ideal for close-range extended viewing in control rooms and conference rooms. COB's flip-chip design provides superior heat dissipation and longer lifespan. GOB (Glue-on-Board) variant available for additional physical protection in high-traffic environments.


### X3-SMD: Indoor Fine Pitch SMD LED Display / HD LED Video Wall

The X3-SMD series is our cost-effective fine pitch indoor LED display using mature SMD (Surface-Mount Device) technology. This HD LED video wall delivers excellent color uniformity, wide viewing angles, and reliable performance at a more accessible price point than COB LED equivalents.

**Available Pixel Pitches:**
- P1.25 SMD LED display — fine pitch indoor LED for premium meeting rooms and boardrooms
- P1.53 SMD LED video wall — HD LED screen for corporate lobbies and retail
- P1.86 SMD LED display — popular fine pitch LED for education, hotels, museums
- P2.0 SMD LED screen — economical indoor LED display for commercial spaces
- P2.5 SMD LED video wall — versatile indoor LED for shopping malls, retail stores, churches
- P3 SMD LED display — standard indoor LED screen for auditoriums and events
- P4 indoor LED display panel — large format indoor LED for stadiums, airports, train stations

**X3-SMD Technical Specifications:**
- Technology: SMD (Surface-Mount Device), GOB LED coating optional
- Pixel Pitch: P1.25, P1.53, P1.86, P2.0, P2.5, P3, P4mm
- Refresh Rate: >=3840Hz
- Brightness: 800-1000 cd/m2
- Cabinet Design: Front service LED display (magnetic module for easy maintenance)
- Module Size: 320 x 160mm (industry standard indoor LED module)
- Cabinet Material: Die-cast aluminum or steel
- Viewing Angle: 160 degree horizontal, 160 degree vertical
- Grayscale: 14-16 Bit

**X3-SMD Target Applications & Keywords:**
Retail store LED display window, shopping mall LED advertising screen, museum LED video wall, education LED display, school LED screen, university LED video wall, hotel LED display, corporate lobby LED screen, shopping mall LED signage, car showroom LED display, fashion store LED video wall, restaurant LED menu board, church LED display wall, worship LED video wall, supermarket LED signage, hospital LED display, bank LED screen, airport LED flight information display, government building LED wall, exhibition hall LED display, casino LED video wall, entertainment venue LED screen

**Front Service LED Design:**
X3-SMD cabinets feature front-access maintenance design — LED modules are held magnetically and can be removed from the front. This is essential when the LED display is wall-mounted with no rear access (typical in retail stores, hotel lobbies, shopping malls, and corporate offices). Front service LED display saves installation space and simplifies maintenance.


### R3 / T3-PRO / T3-Plus: Rental LED Display for Stage, Events, Broadcast

Our rental LED display series is purpose-built for the live event, staging, and touring industry. Featuring die-cast aluminum cabinets with quick-lock rigging systems, these LED screens are designed for rapid deployment, reliable performance, and frequent assembly/disassembly cycles.

**R3 Rental LED Display:**
- Pixel Pitch: P2.6, P2.97, P3.91 (P3.9), P4.81mm
- Cabinet Size: 500x500mm (industry standard rental LED cabinet format)
- Cabinet Material: Die-cast aluminum
- Setup Time: Approximately 5 minutes for standard screen configuration
- Locking System: Quick-lock cam mechanism for tool-free assembly
- Curved Splicing: +/- 10 degree curvature between cabinets
- Service Access: Front and rear service
- Applications: Concert LED screen, event LED display, wedding LED video wall, conference LED backdrop, trade show LED booth, fashion show LED runway, award ceremony LED stage, corporate event LED display, festival LED screen, esports arena LED display, gaming tournament LED wall, live performance LED backdrop

**T3-PRO Broadcast Rental LED Display:**
- Pixel Pitch: P2.6, P2.97, P3.91mm (broadcast-optimized)
- Refresh Rate: 3840Hz (broadcast-grade, zero scan lines on professional cameras)
- Cabinet Size: 500x500mm, also 500x1000mm available
- Curved Splicing: Full curvature flexibility
- Service: Front and rear access
- Applications: Broadcast studio LED wall, TV production LED backdrop, news studio LED screen, virtual production LED volume, XR stage LED display, weather center LED display, esports broadcast LED backdrop

**T3-Plus Ultra-Light Rental LED Display:**
- Pixel Pitch: P2.6, P2.97, P3.91mm
- Weight: 4.8kg per 500x500mm panel (ultra-lightweight, industry-leading)
- Design: Integrated video processor, curved splicing capable
- Applications: Touring concert LED display, festival stage LED video wall, corporate roadshow LED screen, product launch LED backdrop, pop-up event LED display
- Key Advantage: Lightest professional rental LED panel — reduced rigging tonnage requirements, lower transport costs, faster load-in/load-out

**Rental LED Display Keywords:**

### Outdoor LED Display: IP65 Waterproof, High Brightness for Advertising, Sports, DOOH

Our outdoor LED display series delivers high-brightness, weather-resistant LED screens for outdoor advertising, sports venues, building facades, and transportation applications. All outdoor products feature full IP65 front / IP65 or IP54 rear waterproof ratings and are engineered for 24/7 operation in harsh environmental conditions.

**Available Pixel Pitches:**
- P4 outdoor LED display — high-resolution outdoor LED for close-viewing urban locations, pedestrian zones
- P5 outdoor LED screen — popular outdoor LED for city squares, shopping streets, building facades
- P6 outdoor LED display — standard outdoor LED billboard for roadside and highway advertising
- P8 outdoor LED screen — large format outdoor LED for long-distance viewing, stadium perimeter
- P10 outdoor LED display — classic outdoor LED for billboards, sports scoreboards, building wraps

**Outdoor LED Technical Specifications:**
- Technology: SMD outdoor LED (P4-P6), DIP outdoor LED module (P8-P10 for maximum brightness)
- Brightness: 5,000-10,000 cd/m2 (sunlight-readable, auto-adjustable via ambient light sensor)
- Protection Rating: IP65 front, IP65/IP54 rear (full waterproof outdoor LED screen)
- Refresh Rate: >=1920Hz (>=3840Hz for broadcast outdoor LED)
- Cabinet Material: Iron or aluminum outdoor LED cabinet
- Power Supply: Mean Well or equivalent brand 5V power supply
- Temperature Range: -40 degrees C to +60 degrees C operating
- Anti-UV, anti-corrosion treatment on all outdoor LED cabinets
- Remote content management: 4G/Wi-Fi/LAN cloud-based LED content management system
- Pixel Configuration: 1R1G1B SMD or DIP346 for outdoor LED

**Outdoor LED Display Target Applications & Keywords:**
Outdoor advertising LED billboard, LED billboard advertising, DOOH digital out of home LED display, digital outdoor advertising LED screen, roadside LED advertising billboard, highway LED billboard, city square LED display, shopping street LED advertising, building facade LED display, building wrap LED screen, media facade LED, architectural LED display, stadium LED display, sports LED scoreboard, perimeter LED advertising, sports arena LED screen, football stadium LED display, cricket ground LED screen, basketball arena LED display, outdoor event LED screen, open-air concert LED display, outdoor festival LED stage, park LED display, theme park LED screen, amusement park LED video wall, outdoor stage LED backdrop, outdoor digital signage kiosk, bus shelter LED advertising, street furniture LED display, gas station LED price board, outdoor menu board LED, drive-through LED display, outdoor retail LED signage

### Transparent LED Display / LED Glass Screen / See-Through LED Display

Our transparent LED display series combines dynamic digital content with physical transparency, allowing natural light to pass through while displaying brilliant video content. Ideal for glass facade installations where traditional LED screens would block visibility and natural light.

**Transparent LED Display Features:**
- Transparency: 70-90% light transmission (depending on pixel pitch)
- Weight: Ultra-lightweight construction, minimal structural loading on building facades
- Installation: Mounts directly to glass curtain walls, shop windows, atrium railings
- Pixel Pitch: P3.9, P5.2, P7.8, P10, P15.6, P20mm
- Brightness: 5,000-6,000 cd/m2 (visible even in direct sunlight through glass)
- Module Design: Strip-type transparent LED (light bar design) or grid-type transparent LED
- Viewing: Content visible from both front and rear sides
- Power: Very low power consumption (no solid back panel, natural cooling)

**Transparent LED Display Applications & Keywords:**
Transparent LED display, LED glass screen, see-through LED display, transparent LED film, LED glass curtain wall display, shop window LED display, retail storefront transparent LED, shopping mall atrium LED display, airport terminal glass LED display, car showroom glass LED screen, building facade transparent LED, architectural glass LED display, museum glass display LED, exhibition transparent LED screen, jewelry store window LED display, fashion retail window LED, bank glass wall LED, hotel lobby glass LED display, office building atrium LED, trade show transparent LED display, corporate headquarters glass LED, restaurant glass facade LED, skywalk LED display

**Creative LED Display Variations:**
- Transparent LED film: Adhesive-backed transparent LED applied directly to existing glass — no structural modification needed. Peel-and-stick LED film for retail windows, glass partitions, vehicle windows
- 3D naked eye LED display: Anamorphic 3D LED billboard for building corner facades, creating 3D illusion without glasses. 3D billboard LED, naked eye 3D LED screen, immersive 3D outdoor LED advertising
- Spherical LED screen: 360-degree spherical LED display for planetariums, science museums, theme parks, exhibition centers, shopping mall atriums. LED sphere display, globe LED screen, ball-shaped LED display
- Flexible LED screen: Bendable flexible LED module for curved columns, cylindrical LED displays, wavy LED walls, organic architectural shapes. Curved LED display, bendable LED module, flexible LED video wall
- Creative LED custom shape: Custom-shaped LED display for unique architectural installations, brand activations, art installations, themed entertainment venues

- 48-hour continuous burn-in aging test on every LED module before packing
- Brightness and color calibration using industrial spectrophotometer (NovaStar calibration system)
- IP waterproof testing on random sample basis for outdoor products
- Pre-shipment inspection with detailed QC checklist and photo documentation
- Optional: Third-party inspection (SGS, Bureau Veritas, TUV) at buyer's request and cost


## Product Selection Guide & Technical FAQ

**Q: COB vs SMD vs GOB — which LED technology should I choose?**

A: Choose COB LED display for fine pixel pitch (<=P1.86mm), close viewing distances (1-3m), humid or dusty environments, or applications requiring the highest reliability and protection (command centers, broadcast studios, high-end boardrooms). Choose SMD LED display for larger pixel pitches, outdoor use, or budget-sensitive projects where mature technology provides excellent value at competitive pricing. Choose GOB (Glue-on-Board) LED display when you need enhanced physical protection on SMD modules — ideal for rental/staging where modules face frequent handling, or high-traffic indoor installations like retail and education.

**Q: What pixel pitch do I need for my project?**

A: This is the most important specification:
- P0.9-P1.5: 1-3m optimal viewing distance — control rooms, luxury retail, broadcast studios, fine pitch conference rooms
- P1.5-P2.5: 3-6m optimal viewing — meeting rooms, corporate lobbies, retail stores, churches, education
- P2.5-P5: 5-15m optimal viewing — shopping malls, auditoriums, events, rental stages, indoor sports
- P5-P10: 10m+ optimal viewing — outdoor billboards, highway advertising, stadiums, building facades
- P10-P20: 15m+ optimal viewing — large outdoor billboards, building wraps, roadside DOOH, perimeter advertising

Formula: Minimum viewing distance (meters) = Pixel pitch (mm). Optimal viewing distance = 1.5x to 2x the minimum.

**Q: What is your minimum order quantity?**

A: No strict MOQ — we accept orders from 1 square meter for sample evaluation. However, pricing becomes more competitive at 5+ square meters. Distributor and wholesale pricing available for 20+ square meter orders. Container-load pricing for 50+ square meter orders. Contact us for volume pricing tiers.

**Q: How do I get a quote for my LED display project?**

A: To receive an accurate quotation, please provide: (1) Required pixel pitch (e.g., P2.5, P3.91, P5), (2) Desired screen size (width x height in meters or total square meters), (3) Application scenario (indoor/outdoor, fixed/rental, front service/rear service), (4) Target country and nearest seaport/airport for shipping estimate, (5) Any special requirements (curved, 3D, transparent, interactive, custom shape).

Contact us via:
- WhatsApp: +86-172-7666-5558
- Email: info@asiavisionled.com
- Website inquiry form: https://asiavisionled.com

**Q: Can you provide installation support?**

A: Yes. We provide: Comprehensive installation guide (PDF with step-by-step diagrams), installation training videos, remote video support via WhatsApp/Teams/Zoom during your installation, and optional on-site engineer dispatch (factory-trained technician travels to your site). We also regularly recommend qualified local LED display installers and system integrators in your region who can handle professional installation.

**Q: Do you offer customization and OEM/ODM?**

A: Yes. Customizable options include: Cabinet size and color, LED module PCB design for specific form factors, company logo printing on cabinets and modules, custom flight case labels and packaging, custom pixel pitch development for large volume orders, white-label firmware and software loading, customized user manuals in your language. Our R&D team handles ODM projects from concept to mass production.

**Q: What about customs clearance and import duties?**

A: We provide all necessary export documentation: Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/air waybill, certificate of origin (Form A/Form E/Form F for preferential tariffs), CE/FCC/RoHS test reports. Import duties and customs clearance are the buyer's responsibility. We recommend working with a local customs broker. We can recommend freight forwarders and customs brokers we have worked with in your country.
